title: Why is no one calling for an investigation? — series cover
description: Three-part series cover. Part 3 line: take the claims at full strength — then charging is the state’s duty. So why the silence?
alt_text: Dark card: Why is no one calling for an investigation? — editorial, a three-part series. Part 1: every statement demanded Platner’s withdrawal, zero demanded an investigation. Part 2: “we reviewed the evidence” should begin the inquiry, not end it. Part 3: take the claims at full strength — then charging is the state’s duty. So why the silence?
